notes_for_editor: The only lookout source is the Forest Fire Lookout Association list, which is undated and has a blank NHLR/FFLOS column for Grapeland. Grapeland is not on the Forest Lookouts Texas list. Two WebSearch calls turned up no lookout reference; the local history pages read (TSHA, EastTexas.com, Wikipedia, TxGenWeb) mention no tower. Design, agency, year, height and access are unknown. No photos found.
